name: Amie
tagline: A calendar, to-dos, and bot-free AI meeting notes in one app.
description: Amie combines a fast calendar, task management, and an AI meeting note-taker in a single app. It records meetings locally on your device — no bot joins the call — then generates summaries, action items, and follow-up drafts. Natural-language input adds events and tasks, and it connects to tools like Notion, Slack, and Linear.
insight: Founded by ex-N26 product manager Dennis Müller; backed by Creandum, an early Spotify investor.
edge: Records meetings locally on your device with no bot joining the call, bundling notes with a full calendar and to-dos in one app.
pros: Calendar, tasks, and AI notes unified

references.title: Amie is a new calendar app with a social twist
